reviewAdvisory: The figures given establish that China is ASEAN's largest trading partner and ASEAN is China's largest trading partner, but they do not establish that China-ASEAN is the largest bilateral trading relationship either side has, which is a stronger superlative the supplied figures do not contain.

The draft asserts that the parties 'used' the forum 'to signal' convergence, attributing a motive and a deliberate choice to the parties that the supplied evidence does not contain; the report only states the forum's subject and the effective date.

The figures list supplies the forum name, location, attendance and country count, but no figure record names the China Law Society as host, so the host is a named detail the supplied evidence does not contain.

The draft states as fact that post-date shipments are declared under the protocol's rules, but the report does not reproduce the protocol and the figures contain no rule text, so this is a procedural claim the evidence does not support.

The draft asserts delay and re-documentation as the cost of an unacceptable declaration, a consequence the supplied figures do not contain and which is presented as established rather than as the writer's framing.

The disclosure appears only in the confidence section while the body presents the Ministry of Commerce trade figures as independently sourced; the single-source note belongs where the figures are first used, not only at the end.
